faqs.question: What isolation voltage do I need?
faqs.answer: Basic insulation requires 2500Vrms minimum, reinforced insulation requires 5000Vrms. Lite-On optocouplers offer 3750-5000Vrms isolation for industrial and consumer applications.
faqs.decisionGuide: Determine required isolation level from safety standards. Use 3750Vrms for general industrial, 5000Vrms for reinforced insulation.

faqs.question: How do I select between phototransistor and logic gate types?
faqs.answer: Phototransistor optocouplers (LTV-8xx) are economical for slow signals. Logic gate types (LTV-3xx) offer faster switching and better noise immunity for digital communication.
faqs.decisionGuide: Use phototransistor for DC signals and power isolation. Use logic gate for PWM, digital communication, and noisy environments.

faqs.question: What certifications do Lite-On optocouplers have?
faqs.answer: Lite-On optocouplers are certified to UL1577, VDE0884, and CQC standards. These cover isolation voltage, creepage, clearance, and safety requirements for global markets.
faqs.decisionGuide: Verify required certifications for target market. Certificates available upon request from BeiLuo Electronics.

faqs.question: How is CTR affected by temperature?
faqs.answer: CTR varies with temperature - typically increasing at lower temperatures and decreasing at higher temperatures. Design for worst-case CTR over the full operating temperature range with adequate margin.
faqs.decisionGuide: Design with 50-100% safety margin on CTR for reliable operation across temperature. Contact FAE for detailed CTR curves.

faqs.question: What are typical applications for optocouplers?
faqs.answer: Common applications include PLC I/O isolation, motor drive signal isolation, power supply feedback, industrial communication interfaces, and automotive signal isolation.
faqs.decisionGuide: Select optocoupler type based on signal speed and isolation requirements for your specific application.
